/* Add border to the specific 'Discount' custom HTML sidebar */
#custom_html-17 {
    border: 2px solid #30a9dd; /* Set the border color */
    text-align: center; 
    margin-bottom: 15px; /* Space below the widget */
    padding: 0; /* Remove extra padding to align title with box */
    border-radius: 5px; /* Rounded corners */
    background-color: #ffffff; /* Optional: Set background color */
    overflow: hidden; /* Ensures content does not overflow border-radius */
}

/* Apply border and background color to the Discount sidebar title container */
#custom_html-17 .widget-title {
    border-bottom: 2px solid #30a9dd; /* Match the border with the box */
    text-align: center;  /* Centers the text */
    font-weight: bold;   /* Makes the text bold */
    font-size: 18px;     /* Adjusts font size */
    color: #ffffff;      /* Set text color to white */
    background-color: #30a9dd; /* Background color for the title */
    padding: 5px;       /* Adds padding inside the title */
    margin: 0;           /* Removes any default margin */
    width: 100%;         /* Ensures the title takes the full width */
    box-sizing: border-box; /* Includes padding in the element's width */
    border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; /* Apply rounded corners to top only */
    position: relative;  /* Ensure title is layered properly */
    top: -2px; /* Slightly overlap with the parent box to cover corners */
}

/* Add this CSS to center the button */
.sidebar-button-wrapper {
    text-align: center; /* Centers the button in the wrapper */
    display: block; /* Ensure the wrapper uses block display */
}

/* Sidebar Button Default Style */
.sidebar-button {
    display: inline-block;
    background-color: #30a9dd; /* Original background color */
    color: #ffffff !important; /* Ensure text stays white */
    padding: 10px 20px;
    text-decoration: none;
    border-radius: 5px;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-align: center; /* Center-align text */
}

/* Hover Effect for Sidebar Button */
.sidebar-button:hover {
    background-color: #2a91b3; /* Darker background */
    color: #ffffff !important; /* Keep text color the same */
    cursor: pointer; /* Changes cursor to pointer on hover */
}
